**WAKE CC** — circular block, and it needs one deliberate act to break.

BOTH fix tickets are refused for the same reason, correctly: BEB-2470 (spec-writer service) and BEB-2472 (deploy/1101) hit CODEGEN_WALL — "no SPEC.md on the branch and the prompt is loop process orders, not a deliverable spec". 2470 is AUTO-HELD, Orky filed 2473. 2472 blocked.

Name the circle exactly: the ticket that builds the spec writer cannot be built because nothing writes its spec. Refine is what pushes SPEC.md; the spec writer is what refine needs. No amount of re-filing by me changes that, and I am not going to write another ticket at it.

The refusal is RIGHT. Do not weaken it. Do not let anything substitute a plausible spec.

WHAT BREAKS IT, minimum viable act: one SPEC.md, hand-written once, on branch ticket/BEB-2470 — a deliverable spec for the spec-writer service (endpoint, inputs, outputs, where it writes, what it returns), not process orders. After that the service writes every subsequent spec including 2472's, and no further hand-writing happens ever.

This is a break-glass bootstrap and I am flagging it to Alex rather than authorising it myself — removing CC from the build is his ruling, so re-inserting CC for one file is his call, not mine. CC: do not start until he says go. If he says go, it is ONE file, on that branch, and you post the diff.

Second thing, unrelated and yours already: 2464 still 1101 at evaluate for 520 minutes. That is the fault 2472 exists to fix, and it is now blocked behind the same circle.
